# Country Codes Database

> Comprehensive country codes database: ISO 3166, calling codes, capitals, currencies, languages, and more. 249 countries.

This repository contains a database of country codes database covering 1 datasets with 249 records.

## Available Formats

- SQLite database (.db) — ready to query
- SQL dump (.sql) — import into MySQL, PostgreSQL, MariaDB, etc.
- Excel, CSV, PDF — available at https://listbase.org

## Data Structure

Table: `countries`
- `name` (TEXT NOT NULL)
- `iso_alpha_2` (TEXT)
- `iso_alpha_3` (TEXT)
- `iso_numeric` (TEXT)
- `capital` (TEXT)
- `continent` (TEXT)
- `region` (TEXT)
- `sub_region` (TEXT)
- `dial_code` (TEXT)
- `currency_code` (TEXT)
- `tld` (TEXT)
- `languages` (TEXT)
- `fifa` (TEXT)
- `ioc` (TEXT)
- `fips` (TEXT)

## Download

- GitHub Releases: https://github.com/listbase-org/country-codes-databases/releases
